versions.changelog: Add explicit safety disclaimer: placard authoritative, professional inspection guidance

Initial release of Tire Pressure Coach.

- Calculates precise tire pressure targets using real physics, including temperature and altitude corrections.
- Busts common tire-pressure myths (placard vs sidewall max, nitrogen, equalizing all tires).
- Provides load, speed, and seasonal pressure adjustment guidance.
- Includes tread-depth safety verdicts with wet-grip context and legal limits.
- Offers TPMS code interpretation and a scheduler for monthly pressure checks.
- Step-by-step commands for placard entry, pressure/tread checks, fill-to calculations (cold/hot), and logging.
